links.outcome: Comprehension and anxiety with vs without LLM patient-friendly summary of lung cancer screening reports
links.effect: Adding a patient summary improved objective comprehension (P<.001) and reduced anxiety (P<.001) in all scenarios; gains were larger for low self-rated English literacy (comprehension P<.001; anxiety P=.012) and health literacy (anxiety P<.001).
links.quote: LLM-generated PS of lung cancer screening reports increase comprehension and reduce anxiety, most notably among individuals with lower self-rated English and health literacy.

screen.reason: Vignette-based human reader survey evaluating the effect of LLM-generated patient-friendly summaries of radiology reports on comprehension and anxiety.
